chunks: He will forgive you your sins and admit you to gardens with rivers flowing by, and excellent mansions in the garden of Eden. This will be a great fulfilment.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of 'great fulfillment' (al-fawz al-'azim) in the context of divine reward?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tradition as a supplication for the faithful, highlights the dual nature of divine reward: the removal of past sins and the bestowal of eternal, superior dwellings in Jannah. The phrase 'that is the great success' (dhālika al-fawz al-ʿaẓīm) underscores the culmination of spiritual striving, a concept frequently linked in Shia exegesis to the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt and the ultimate attainment of nearness to Allah.
